description: This file is an installation script for an ERP system (ERPNext) which automates setup procedures such as creating default roles, custom fields, configuration settings, UI elements, and energy point rules during installation or reinstallation.

methods.name: after_install()
methods.description: Executes all setup and configuration steps after the installation process, such as creating roles, custom fields, role permissions, and UI elements.

methods.name: check_setup_wizard_not_completed()
methods.description: Checks whether the setup wizard has been completed; throws an exception if installation is attempted on a site where setup is already complete.

methods.name: set_single_defaults()
methods.description: Sets default configurations for various system settings, as per existing database entries.

methods.name: create_compact_item_print_custom_field()
methods.description: Creates a custom checkbox field 'Compact Item Print' in Print Settings.

methods.name: create_print_uom_after_qty_custom_field()
methods.description: Creates a custom checkbox field 'Print UOM after Quantity' in Print Settings.

methods.name: create_print_zero_amount_taxes_custom_field()
methods.description: Creates a custom checkbox field 'Print taxes with zero amount' in Print Settings.

methods.name: create_default_cash_flow_mapper_templates()
methods.description: Creates default cash flow mapper templates if they do not already exist.

methods.name: create_default_success_action()
methods.description: Creates default success actions based on predefined configuration.

methods.name: create_default_energy_point_rules()
methods.description: Creates default energy point rules if they do not already exist for the specified reference doctypes.

methods.name: add_company_to_session_defaults()
methods.description: Adds a 'Company' reference doctype to the session default settings.

methods.name: add_standard_navbar_items()
methods.description: Adds standard navigation bar items such as Documentation, User Forum, and Report an Issue.

methods.name: add_app_name()
methods.description: Sets the application name to 'ERPNext' in system settings.

methods.name: add_non_standard_user_types()
methods.description: Creates custom user types and roles, such as 'Employee Self Service', and updates site configuration accordingly.

methods.name: get_user_types_data()
methods.description: Returns data for various user types, including roles, permissions, and associated doctypes.

methods.name: create_custom_role(data)
methods.description: Creates a new custom role if it does not already exist.

methods.name: create_user_type(user_type, data)
methods.description: Creates or updates a user type with associated roles and permissions.

methods.name: create_role_permissions_for_doctype(doc, data)
methods.description: Assigns permission levels for specific doctypes to a user type.

methods.name: update_select_perm_after_install()
methods.description: Updates select permissions after installation if required, reloading user type configurations.
